## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the defensive problem, affected scope, capability stage and concrete change.

## Evidence and validation

State relevant primary sources/refs/licenses, baseline, tests and results. Separate local checks from actual pilot/production acceptance. Include failure and negative cases for behavioral changes.

## Safety and limits

- [ ] Scope, authority, data sensitivity and action risks reviewed.
- [ ] Evidence/proposals/approvals/receipts/verification remain distinct.
- [ ] Relevant sanitization, timeout, cancellation and failure paths tested.
- [ ] No secrets, private incident evidence, fake success or production mock data.
- [ ] Upstream provenance/license and behavior documents updated when applicable.
- [ ] Unchecked or inapplicable items have an explicit reason below.
